integrity.first_public_evidence: arXiv:2402.16999v1 was posted 2024-02-26; the journal article was published later in 2025.
integrity.proof: Finite-dimensional exact commutant and spectral argument; numerical tests corroborate but do not establish universal quantifiers.
integrity.scientific_claim: Exact all-input stationary channel, fixed algebra, entanglement-breaking property, directional discord and preparation-sensitive battery ergotropy for the specified Lindbladian.
integrity.scope: Scientific results are conditional on the exact model; third-party source papers are cited rather than reproduced.

scientific_limitations: Exact resonance, strictly positive drive, exchange coupling and local Markovian charger dephasing are required.
The joint density-matrix limit holds in the rotating frame, not as an unrotated laboratory-frame static state.
The limiting map is entanglement-breaking, with no assertion about a finite-time entanglement-breaking threshold.
An arbitrary prepared input may already contain work resources; arbitrary-input ergotropy maxima must not be interpreted as free charging gains.
Equivalence with an unidentified published or supplementary derivation is a residual originality risk.
title: An exact entanglement-breaking asymptotic channel for a dephased two-qubit battery
